svg.desc: A model registry: immutable version folders v1, v2 and v3, each with a model file and metadata, a CURRENT file pointing at the live version, an append-only history log, and rollback as rewriting CURRENT.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A registry: immutable versions and one pointer

svg.text: artifacts/registry/ - every vN/ folder holds model.joblib + metadata.json.
